name: Claims and Evidence Detection Dataset
description: A dataset for automatic detection of claims and their supporting evidence in the context of controversial topics.
reputation: Used in argument mining and misinformation research with moderate adoption; helpful for claim/evidence extraction studies but not as widely used as large-scale fact-checking benchmarks.
notes: Annotation subjectivity and class imbalance can introduce label noise; evidence linking across posts is challenging. Dataset may be modest in size and domain-specific (controversial topics), so contamination and domain shift risk exist; primarily a non-LLM / information-extraction benchmark.
